title: Strategic Account Executive Enterprise - DACH
description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy   Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital,  Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. The Mission 🪐 The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption. The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond. Key Responsibilities ✨ Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units). Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps. Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity. Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams. Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value. Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate. Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams. Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans. Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum). Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍 Proven Mastery (What you have already built): A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment. Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups. Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals. Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English. Skills You Will Deploy & Develop: Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances. C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work." Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration. The Self-Selection Filter ❓ This role is perfect for you if: You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape. You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute. You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings." This role is NOT for you if: You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers. You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes. You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition. 30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁 Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy. Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline. Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance . Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line. How to join the mission? 🚀 First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive. Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo , to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor. Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery. Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth. Diese Rolle ist gleichzeitig die seniorste und die operativste im Growth-Bereich. Du führst heute ein kleines Team und in einem Jahr ein echtes – und lieferst die ganze Zeit über selbst ab.

Parallel besetzen wir eine Vertriebsleitung. Growth verantwortet das Go-to-Market end to end; wie die Vertriebsleitung dazu steht, gestalten wir mit der Person, die zuerst an Bord ist.

Was du machst

  • Du verantwortest Pipeline-Generierung als wichtigste Zahl des Unternehmens – end to end, nicht kanalweise
  • Du skalierst Paid Acquisition um ein Vielfaches und hältst dabei den CAC-Payback unter drei Monaten – und entscheidest, wann wir das inhouse holen
  • Du verantwortest Positionierung und Category Creation. mika ist die Finanz- und Steuerabteilung für Unternehmen, die zu klein für eine eigene sind – nie eine Buchhaltungssoftware
  • Du machst aus Partnerschaften einen messbaren Kanal und entwickelst unsere Kundenbasis zu einer Community
  • Du verantwortest neben der Demand- auch die Sales-Engine: Lane-Definition, Rep Economics, Win Rate, Cycle Time und ACV
  • Du baust und führst das Team – du entscheidest, welche Rolle wann kommt, und stellst sie selbst ein

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • AI-native, nicht AI-curious. Claude oder Vergleichbares ist dein täglicher Sparringspartner, kein Tool, das du gelegentlich öffnest.
  • Du hebst deinen eigenen Output damit und automatisierst die Teile deines Jobs, für die es keinen Menschen brauchen sollte. In dieser Rolle heißt das: die Analysen und Reportings, auf die du sonst warten müsstest – und denselben Anspruch an alle, die du einstellst.
  • Du hast ein Unternehmen von rund 1 Mio. auf über 10 Mio. ARR gebracht – oder in einer früheren Rolle das erreicht, was wir uns für die nächsten 365 Tage vornehmen.
  • Output vor Planung. Du wirst daran gemessen, was jede Woche live geht, nicht an Decks. Der Fehler, den wir nicht wiederholen: starke Analysen, aus denen nie ausgelieferte Arbeit wird.
  • Du hast Paid in den sechsstelligen Monatsbereich skaliert und eine Content-Engine aufgebaut – und kannst Assets zeigen, die du selbst produziert oder direkt verantwortet hast
  • Du skalierst von zwei auf zehn Leute, ohne die zehn zum Start zu brauchen
  • First Principles und quantitativ. Du modellierst den Funnel, planst Quartale im Voraus und benennst die Metriken, an denen du gemessen werden willst, ohne dass man dich fragt.Selbststeuernd.
  • Du siehst das Problem, bevor wir es ansprechen – und handelst.
  • Geschmack. Du kannst beurteilen, ob ein Creative einem Premium-Anspruch genügt. Marke ist unser Distributions-Moat, und Qualität lässt sich nicht an Juniors delegieren.
  • Belastbar in direkter Kommunikation. Du arbeitest mit drei meinungsstarken, operativen Foundern und gibst und nimmst klares Feedback ohne Drama.

nice to have

  • Deutsche KMU-Zielgruppe, Fintech oder eine andere regulierte Kategorie
  • Category Creation dort, wo es kein Suchvolumen gab
  • Community-Aufbau
  • Du hast schon ein kleines Growth-Team eingestellt und geführt

kein Fit

  • Du brauchst ein großes Team oder gewachsene Strukturen, bevor du lieferst
  • Du führst über Strategie-Decks, wartest auf Briefings oder steuerst vor allem Agenturen
  • Du hast keinen eigenen Output vorzuweisen und keine Meinung zu unserem Funnel im ersten Gespräch

Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher ist Voraussetzung. Unsere Zielgruppe, unsere Inhalte und unsere Sales-Gespräche sind deutsch – und du verantwortest die Sprache, die mika spricht. Englisch auf B2-Niveau oder höher, da Englisch unsere Teamsprache ist.

Benefits

Grundgehalt 80.000 bis 130.000 EUR je nach Erfahrung, dazu ein variabler Anteil. Er hängt am Anfang stärker an dem, was du selbst abschließt, und verschiebt sich mit dem wachsenden Team in Richtung Teamleistung.

Drei Runden: ein erstes Kennenlernen, eine Arbeitssession mit einem kurzen Case und eine letzte Runde mit den Gründern. Für eine Rolle auf diesem Level kommt ein viertes Gespräch mit einem unserer Investoren oder Mentoren dazu. Ein Termin findet in Berlin persönlich statt, und du hörst in jeder Stufe innerhalb einer Woche von uns, auch wenn die Antwort nein ist.

Warum mika?

  • Kein Budgetdeckel. Die Einmalaufträge, die Kund:innen mitbringen, decken die Akquise am ersten Tag. Solange der CAC hält, gibst du aus, was du brauchst.
  • Die Rolle trägt die wichtigste Zahl des Unternehmens – mit den passenden Befugnissen
  • Direkter Draht zu den Foundern und ein Platz bei jeder Entscheidung, die Growth berührt
  • Eine Kategorie zum Aufbauen statt eines Marktanteils zum Verteidigen
  • De facto C-Level. Für die richtige Person kann die Rolle den CMO-Titel tragen
  • Berlin, keine festen Bürotage. Komm so oft, wie es braucht, um dein Team zu führen – das entscheidest du

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, die Zahlen, die du bewegt hast, und wie – plus eine Sache, die du an unserem Funnel ändern würdest, nachdem du zwanzig Minuten daraufgeschaut hast.

Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

Du brauchst also kein Visum, um bei uns einzusteigen – nur deine außergewöhnlichen Fähigkeiten und viel Leidenschaft für herausragende Kommunikation. Und dabei macht jede*r Einzelne den Unterschied.

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Konzeption von vielseitigen Kommunikationsmaßnahmen (Offline & Online)
  • Entwicklung von außergewöhnlichen Ideen
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten innerhalb eines Teams
  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung von Film- und Foto-Produktionen

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Kreativagentur, auf nationalen wie internationalen Marken und digitalem Background
  • Shooting-Erfahrung (Film & Foto)
  • Sicheres Gespür für Typografie und gute Gestaltung
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Souveräner Umgang mit den Programmen der Creative Suite
  • Ein Kopf, der voller kreativer Ideen steckt

Benefits

  • Eine tragende Rolle in einer stetig wachsenden Agentur
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit einem starken Team an deiner Seite
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • Vielseitiges Kundenspektrum mit großen Marken und international eingesetzten Kampagnen
  • Unterstützung in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, sowie agentureigene Weiterbildungsveranstaltungen (Panama-Academy)
  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung und einen Zuschuss für deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit mobilem Arbeiten an zwei Tagen pro Woche und der Möglichkeit für Workation
  • 30 Urlaubstage und ein umfassendes Gesundheitsmanagement mit Sportkurs, Betriebsarzt und Vorsorgeangeboten
  • Täglich frisches Obst, Mineralwasser, Kaffee und Tee. Und nach Feierabend auch kühles Bierchen oder ein Glas Sekt.
  • Zentrale Lage mit unmittelbarer Nähe zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und für alle Sport-Fans: Bikeleasing
  • Legendäre Mitarbeiter*innenevents und verschiedene Panama Atletico Sportangebote – Fußball, Laufen, Skiausfahrten und noch vieles mehr

Interessiert? Zeig uns, was Du kannst, und sende uns deine vollständige Bewerbung. Vergiss bitte nicht, uns deinen nächstmöglichen Eintrittstermin sowie deine Gehaltsvorstellung mitzuteilen. Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen!

Panama Werbeagentur GmbH
Eugensplatz 1 | 70184 Stuttgart

title: Senior Mobile Security Developer
description: Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations. This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site. The Role As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions. This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems. Key aspects of the role include: Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements. Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies. Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals. Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams. Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations. Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success. What you'll bring: We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring: Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques. Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls. Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues. Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls. Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working. Desirable knowledge & experience: Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio. Mobile Development & DevSecOps: Knowledge of Android/iOS development, secure development practices, DevSecOps tooling, testing, and automation frameworks. Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly. Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries. What to expect from our hiring process 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model. 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation. 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework. Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one Our Benefits We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect: Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions. Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones. Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind. Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are. Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth. Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts. Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs. Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.</p> <h2><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h2> <p>You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.</p> <h2><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h2> <p>You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.</p> <h3><strong>Regional growth strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the UKI &amp; Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.</li> <li>Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.</li> <li>Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.</li> <li>Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.</li> <li>Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.</li> <li>Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operating rhythm and execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.</li> <li>Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.</li> <li>Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.</li> <li>Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.</li> <li>Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-functional leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the connective tissue between the UKI &amp; Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.</li> <li>Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.</li> <li>Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.</li> <li>Represent UKI &amp; Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.</li> <li>Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Insights and storytelling</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.</li> <li>Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.</li> <li>Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.</li> <li>Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h2> <p>To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:</p> <ul> <li>12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution&nbsp;</li> <li>Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation</li> <li>Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership</li> <li>Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates</li> <li>Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Additional</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech</li> <li>Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week.&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£126,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£158,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.&nbsp; We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. Your expertise in Python, <span data-highlighted="true" data-vc="highlighted-text"><span class="_kqswh2mm"><span class="_5pioz8co _189e1dm9 _1il9buyh _19lc184f _d0altlke" data-testid="definition-highlighter">DBT</span></span></span>, SQL, and Databricks will drive operational efficiency, accelerate our month-end close, and deliver strategic insights that inform capital allocation and IPO readiness. This is a greenfield opportunity to own the analytics roadmap, work directly with Finance leadership, and build infrastructure that powers both scaling and compliance, all at a pivotal moment for Mews</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Design and develop analytical features that surface actionable insights for Finance leadership</li> <li>Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL</li> <li>Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques</li> <li>Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders</li> <li>Collaborate across Finance to translate business requirements into technical implementations</li> <li>Advocate for modern data practices and continuous improvement of the stack</li> </ul> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Hands-on production experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines (minimum 3 years)</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and Python; strong experience with DBT or equivalent modern data transformation tools</li> <li>Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly</li> <li>Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture</li> <li>Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems</li> <li>Demonstrated commitment to data quality, testing and accuracy; take pride in work that's been thoroughly validated</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> In this role, you'll redesign how Finance approaches data discovery and analysis using AI—not just automating your own work, but building patterns and tools that shape how the whole team questions data and validates insights. You'll use AI to accelerate model development and testing, but critically, you'll actively question what it produces and know when to push back. You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.</li> <li><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to&nbsp;<a class="underline underline underline-offset-2 decoration-1 decoration-current/40 hover:decoration-current focus:decoration-current" href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI</li> <li>Background working with regulated or governed data</li> <li>Experience scaling analytics in fast-growing startups or scale-ups</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€46.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€65.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Czechia</div><div class="pay-range"><span>867 000 Kč</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>1 598 000 Kč CZK</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£49,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£55,500 GBP</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">France</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$54,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$65,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Data Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure&nbsp;</strong>for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.<br><br>Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.<br><br>Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.<br><br><strong>Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.</strong><br><br><strong>Our Team Members:</strong></p> <p>We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!<br><br>We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.</p></div><p><strong>Your Role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Head of Data Platform to lead Alpaca’s growing Platform Engineering team. You will own the data strategy, the team’s execution, and the department’s roadmap.</p> <p>The Data department serves every function at Alpaca: it powers partner invoicing and revenue attribution, provides the analytical foundation for sales, product, and compliance, and operates the data platform that processes hundreds of millions of events daily. You will manage three team leads, balancing operational delivery (invoicing, embedded analytics, regulatory reporting) with strategic bets (self-service warehouse, AI-powered analytics, enterprise search).</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. You will set direction for the team while staying close enough to the technical details to make architecture decisions, unblock your leads, and represent data’s capabilities to the executive team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>Things You Get To Do:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead and develop Platform Engineering &amp; ETL</li> <li>Manage leads, set priorities, and ensure delivery.</li> <li>Own the Data Lakehouse architecture: Trino, Iceberg/GCS, Airflow, Airbyte, Redpanda CDC, dbt.</li> <li>Make build-vs-buy decisions on tooling.</li> <li>Drive partner invoicing accuracy and evolution: ensure invoicing logic is versioned, reproducible, and scales with new pricing mechanisms and product launches.</li> <li>Deliver embedded analytics: expose warehouse data to partners via BrokerDash, SSR pipelines, and API-based reporting. Own row-level security and entitlements.</li> <li>Support product launches with data change management: coordinate data impact analysis for new products (fixed income, global stocks, perps, 24/5 trading) across downstream datasets, dashboards, and reverse ETL.</li> <li>Accelerate self-service: move the organization toward self-serve analytics via semantic layers, data catalogues, and conversational BI so the data team can shift from ad-hoc queries to strategic projects.</li> <li>Guide AI/ML enablement: oversee enterprise AI search, agent-based workflow automation, and LLM-powered analytics. Help balance vendor solutions with in-house development.</li> <li>Collaborate with Finance, Sales, Product, Compliance, and Customer Success to translate business needs into data products.</li> <li>Manage infrastructure costs: keep data + cloud cost ratio under target as AUC grows.</li> <li>Operate production systems: own on-call processes, incident response, and SLOs for data freshness, accuracy, and availability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Must-Haves):</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in data engineering, including 3+ years managing data teams (leads + ICs).</li> <li>Deep experience with modern data stack: dbt, Trino/Presto or equivalent query engines, Apache Iceberg or similar table formats, cloud object storage.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT patterns at scale: CDC (Debezium/Kafka), batch (Airflow/dbt), streaming, and reverse ETL.</li> <li>Track record of building self-service analytics capabilities for non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with financial data: trading, invoicing, revenue attribution, or regulatory reporting in fintech or financial services.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and SQL. Comfortable reading code, reviewing PRs, and making architecture decisions.</li> <li>Experience managing distributed/remote teams across multiple time zones.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management: you can translate between executive priorities and engineering execution.</li> <li>Experience with GCP (GKE, GCS, BigQuery migration), Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with brokerage or broker-dealer operations (clearing, settlement, market making, reconciliation).</li> <li>Familiarity with LLM/AI tooling: MCP, vector databases, enterprise search, conversational BI (WrenAI, Cube).</li> <li>Background in compliance analytics (AML/Actimize, KYC, margin calls).</li> <li>Exposure to open-source data catalogues (OpenMetadata, Collate) and data quality frameworks.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>How We Take Care of You:</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive Salary &amp; Stock Options</span></li> <li style="text-align: justify;">Health Benefits</li> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card</span></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.<br></span></em></p> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><a href="https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/AlpacaRecruitmentPrivacyPolicy.pdf"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recruitment Privacy Policy</span></em></a></span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Commercial AE is where incident.io's growth gets made real - you're in front of the most ambitious digital-native companies out there, and the deals you close show up in the trajectory of the whole business.

What that looks like day to day

This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game.

You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly.

We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread.

What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it. incident.io is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge.

AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook.

The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there.

Who you are

  • You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up.

  • Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you.

  • You're genuinely curious about what it's like to be an on-call engineer. Not just the technical side - the stress, the 2am pages, the pressure of being the person whose job it is to fix things fast. That empathy shows up in how you sell.

  • You can hold a technical conversation without leaning on your SE every time. You'll have support when you need it, but you're comfortable going deep on your own.

  • You're scrappy in the best sense - you don't wait for resources, you figure it out. A bigger company with more tools, more inbound, and more hand-holding would actually frustrate you.

  • You pick up the phone. Cold calling doesn't make you wince, and a voicemail doesn't derail your afternoon.

  • Startup life genuinely appeals to you - not as a stepping stone, but because you want to be somewhere your work is visible and your impact is real.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover, we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

That moment matters more than most people realise. You'll make sure it's warm, considered, and sets exactly the right tone. Working closely with the People and Talent teams, you will: Ensure interview days run smoothly, including preparing rooms and coordinating logistics Be the welcoming face for candidates on interview days, stepping in as the on-site host when the Talent team aren't available Send welcome emails to new joiners ahead of their start date and add them to the new starter programme calendar Arrange travel for new joiners who are onboarding at another Orbital office Meet new joiners on their first day and lead the office induction alongside IT Act as the primary office point of contact throughout the onboarding period Reinforce and strengthen our employer brand through every in-person interaction with candidates and new joiners A brilliant office initiative that nobody knows about isn't brilliant. You'll make sure people are informed, excited, and showing up - by communicating clearly, consistently, and with real personality. Standardising the global office experience: Working alongside our US Office Lead to ensure that everyone at Orbital has a great office experience, regardless of where they are based. High standards, discretion and strong attention to detail Strong operational reliability: you create systems so basics don’t break Proactive ownership: you don’t wait for detailed briefs Background in hospitality or events Why this might not be for you You see operational work as beneath you. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

Orbital's London office isn't just a place to sit - it's where culture comes to life, where collaboration gets real, and where the best version of our company shows up every day. We need someone to own that.

As Workplace Experience Manager, you'll be the person who makes in-person time feel intentional, energising, and genuinely worth showing up for. You'll spot what needs improving before anyone else does, elevate what's already good into something exceptional, and care deeply about the details that most people never notice - but everyone feels.

This isn't a head-down admin role, and it's not a purely strategic one either. We want someone who can define what "great" looks like and then go make it happen - someone equally at home rethinking the summer party concept and making sure the snacks never run out.

You'll report into our Head of Operations and be based in our London office five days a week.

What You'll Do

Elevate the Workplace Experience

Our office should feel like the best version of Orbital - energising, considered, and somewhere people genuinely want to be. You'll own that. Not by waiting for someone to point out a problem, but by constantly asking what would make this better - and then making it happen.

You will:

  • Assess what’s working and what isn’t, and proactively improve it

  • Develop clear concepts and briefs

  • Create simple communication plans to drive attendance and engagement

  • Design lightweight feedback loops, analyse results, and continuously improve

Run a flawless operation

Great workplace experience starts with a workplace that just works. Snacks stocked. Meeting rooms set up. Vendors sorted. You'll build the systems and habits that keep the fundamentals running so smoothly that nobody has to think about them - because you already have.

You will own:

  • The overall standards and day-to-day functioning of the office environment

  • Vendor relationships, facilities coordination, and office supplies

  • Organising weekly lunches and keeping snacks stocked

title: Product Analyst
description: London/Hybrid £40,000 - £60,000 + share options up to £14,500 + Benefits 💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. The team We have a massive vision and even more ideas, but right now, our ambitions are outstripping our capacity. That’s where you come in. We aren't looking for someone to just "run the reports" we’re looking for a foundational member of a growing function who is excited to help us redefine how data influences product. At Accurx, we don't just wait for a roadmap to be handed down; we expect everyone to help shape it. While you'll be part of a team of expert data and product leaders, you'll be the one in the driver's seat for your domain. You won't be watching from the sidelines - you'll be proactively hunting for insights, challenging our current assumptions, and taking ownership of how data can save clinician time from day one. This is a role for a critical thinker who is energised by the "blank canvas" of a growing function and has the drive to turn raw data into a better reality for millions of patients. raw.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole. 

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond. 

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements. 

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR. 

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests. 

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers. 

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level. 

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation. 

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively. 

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace. 


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments. 

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data. 

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre. 

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter. 


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) 

What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Fullstack Engineer - Subscriptions
description: The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners. Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services. As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale. What You'll Do Build end-to-end features across modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms that support Spotify's global subscription business. Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows. Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that power subscriptions, prepaid products, pricing, promotions, and the offer lifecycle. Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services. Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL. Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows. Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability. Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement. Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium. Who You Are You have experience building and delivering production software across both frontend and backend technologies. You have experience developing scalable backend services using modern Java, with Java 17+ experience being a plus. You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications. You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems. You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization. You care about writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software that delivers long-term value. You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes. You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users. Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly. Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial. Where You'll Be We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zones for collaboration. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.   At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: People Operations Lead - 3 month FTC
description: 📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home 📅 Initial 3 month FTC - potential option for extension or perm. ⏰ 40 hour week ideally although 30-32 hours considered. 🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential. ✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered. We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next! About the role We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director. This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience. First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience. And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing. Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work . We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again. This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better. You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done! You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them. You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord. And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us? We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better. If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you. Who are you? You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently. raw.title: People Operations Lead - 3 month FTC
raw.description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home

📅 Initial 3 month FTC - potential option for extension or perm.

⏰ 40 hour week ideally although 30-32 hours considered.

🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.


✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!


About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing.

Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work.

We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You'll want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

What does that mean in practice?

  • You're naturally curious and analytical. You ask good questions, get underneath problems and use data rather than instinct alone to make decisions.

  • You love improving how things work. You've reviewed, redesigned and implemented processes rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and a confident collaborator. You can turn an idea into something that actually works and bring people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Previous professional experience working as an accountant or in a substantive accountancy role. This is essential for this particular hire.

  • Significant People Operations experience, with evidence that you've owned and designed end-to-end People processes, not simply operated processes someone else created.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data using a modern tech stack, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're of course open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems, alongside strong analytical and advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including ownership of pay review cycles, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement - spotting friction, getting underneath the root cause and leading meaningful changes that have made processes simpler, better or more scalable.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. You'll be comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working.

  • You'll be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech to solve problems and make change happen.

It would also be great if you have

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

And one thing you won't need

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

A little more about the contract

This is initially a three-month fixed-term contract. We're continuing to think about the longer-term shape of our People team, so there is the potential for the role to become permanent if there's a strong mutual fit and an ongoing need.

We're also open to part-time working for the right person. Finding the right combination of People Operations and professional accountancy experience matters more to us than insisting on a particular working pattern.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,500 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 300+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.
